meta.concept: Perimeter-first machine room (iteration 2's winner, variant A, with the judges' grafts from variant B): continuous machine rows along every usable wall (the 3420 tape string on the left wall, the 1401 line-up across the head wall, a 3350 string standing free on its rear service aisle and closed by the down-flow air unit on the right), a T-bar ceiling with troffer rows over the aisles, a raised floor, and a working office zone of desks and tables at 74 cm with the small computers on them; her at the 1407 with the 3420 string receding behind her left shoulder
meta.units: Unreal cm / degrees, Z up, X from the street glass (x = 0) toward the vermilion feature wall (x = 1150), Y right; yaw turns +X toward +Y
meta.date: 1979: 'LONGVIEW LAB, Bay 7, est. 1959, as it stood in the autumn of 1979'. The 1959-64 1401 installation (CPU, 1406, 1402, 1403, six 729s, the 1405) is the lab's older system, still in service; the 1970s additions are a 3803/3420 tape string, a 3350 disk string (both cabled under the floor to the 370 in Bay 6), 3277 display stations on the operators' desks, the IBM 029 card punch and a Selectric II, and the research corner (Kenbak-1 1971, Xerox Alto 1973, the 1968 SRI mouse, a Commodore PET 2001 1977, a Tektronix 465-class oscilloscope). Nothing after 1979: the 1982 CP-500 stays out

meta.exposureNote: Solved on Unreal HOME captures of this room (game view from the editor with -RenderOffscreen, the street-side lights culled as after the cut), 2026-11-13: a bracket at EV100 4.5 / 4.7 / 4.9 / 5.4 gave a frame mean of 123 / 118 / 113 / 101 (of 255), and a capture at 4.6 measured 119.5. The 1963 room's 5.4 left this frame darker: the passage behind her head is wider and taller. What clips above 240 is the placeholder mannequin's chrome; elsewhere under 1 % of the frame (the clock face, the 1401 panel's glow). Re-solve the same way, on a captured HOME frame, whenever the lights, the emissives or the resident change.
meta.emissiveUnits: cd/m2: a blockout's emissive E gives a displayed luminance of E x Y(color), Y the luminance of its sRGB colour decoded to linear. Colours of emissive blockouts are DISPLAY colours (as they read after the meta.whiteBalanceK white balance); author_diorama.py and previz_diorama.py turn them into scene colours with the inverse of that white balance. Calibrated against the candela lights: each troffer carries the luminance of the bay light over its row, I / A of that light's 120 x 300 cm rect (261-319 cd/m2 emissive, 240-293 cd/m2 displayed), the acoustic tile and the T-bar a small emissive for the bounce, the rest is set against the white point of the HOME exposure (about 80 cd/m2 at EV100 6)
meta.lightColorEncoding: lights[].srgb is the light colour sRGB-ENCODED (a colour picker's or a kelvin table's value); both tools decode it to linear before use. lights[].linear, when present, is already linear.

zones.officeZone: the street half: the research corner, the programmers' 2 x 2 and the typing desk. Fabric task chairs in orange, brown and mustard, desk lamps, greenbar listings, card trays, IBM manuals between bookends, mugs, pencil cups, phones; amber glass ashtrays are allowed here only
zones.machineFloor: the strings, their aisles, the 1407 console desk, the operators' bench, the worktable and the 029: a raised floor on a depressed slab (flush with the street door, no ramp) with perforated panels and cable cut-outs, the NO SMOKING sign, the EPO station, CO2 extinguishers at the row ends, the tape cart, the tape-library racks and the run sheet on the 3420 string's end; no ashtrays

shots.name: VITRINE
shots.purpose: Lobby still and first frame for every visitor: the night storefront from the pavement, 20 deg to the glass on the street -> open door -> her eyes line, held until the gesture. The 3420 string recedes along the left wall to the dark passage; she is small at the 1407 console desk; LONGVIEW letters over the 1401 line-up across the head wall; the operators' bench with its 3277 displays in the middle; continuous troffer rows in the T-bar ceiling over every aisle; the run-sheet clipboard on the string's street end. The lobby copy and 'Step inside' sit on the dark canopy band.

beats.name: Lobby
beats.trigger: no session yet: a stream waits for its first viewer (the data channel opening), a kiosk for the level load; back here within 2 s of the last viewer leaving
beats.resident: at work: body turned 30 deg from the lens toward the printout on the 1407 at her left (yaw 140), head down 26 deg; idle loop (reads, turns a page, glances along the 3420s)
beats.lights: night state: continuous troffer rows over the three machine aisles and the workspace in the T-bar ceiling, desk lamps, the oscilloscope's trace, soffit cans, lightbox, office floors; reels creep along the 3420 string; 1401 lamps idle; the clock runs on host time
beats.ui: CI lobby (UI-less frontend) over a build-time still of this exact frame: CI mark, honest status ('Connecting to the room.' then 'She's at work. Step inside when you're ready.'), 'She speaks out loud. Sound on.', one button 'Step inside', all in the dark canopy band (x 0.06-0.48, y 0.10-0.31). AutoConnect + StartVideoMuted; Epic's UI hidden; the still dissolves (200 ms) onto identical live pixels

cue.holdNote: session start (the viewer connecting, or the level load) to the cut inside; 0.3 s when the visitor's own key, click or Esc starts it; MHLLM_OPENING_DELAY overrides (the CI lobby page's session-start gesture replaces the viewer trigger when it exists)

beats.name: Step inside
beats.trigger: gesture G: click/tap 'Step inside', Enter, Space (page emitUIInteraction {type:'session-start', reducedMotion, orientation, returning})
beats.ui: lobby fades (150 ms); audio unmuted by the gesture; J-cut: the glass door's push bar, the night street bed (a distant streetcar bell) ducks, the room tone (one 60 Hz hum, fans, a 1403 burst) swells: the room is heard before it is seen. Engine: reset conversation, transcript, gaze, console and settings; warm the model (keep_alive)

beats.name: Arrival
beats.trigger: session-start + 0.3 s: CUT (SetGameCameraCutThisFrame) to ARRIVAL key 0, an axial cut-in on the door line
beats.resident: at work; her eyes lift at G+0.8 s (she heard the door)
beats.lights: exterior and window-display lights culled after the cut
beats.ui: her caption zone only; transcript hidden until its first entry; no input row yet

beats.name: Distance salutation
beats.trigger: move t = 1.3 s (G+1.6 s), the camera still walking
beats.resident: head comes up 20 deg, eyes to the lens, eyebrow flash; cached WAV 'Oh, hello.' through SpeakLiteral; then a glance back to the printout to finish the line she was reading
beats.lights: 3420 186's READY lamp blinks once (the room notices too)

beats.name: Look up
beats.trigger: camera within 3.5 m of her eyes (move t = 2.55 s, G+2.8 s)
beats.resident: the close greeting begins: eyes to the live camera first, head 150-250 ms later over 0.45 s, body turns 30 deg back from the desk (140 -> 170) over 0.95 s; faceless rig: head, neck and chest

beats.name: Settle
beats.trigger: camera under 2 cm/s (move t = 5.15 s); the move ends on HOME at 5.56 s
beats.resident: eye contact; soft smile onset if the rig has one

beats.name: Turn-yield line
beats.resident: cached WAV, <= 12 words about this room ending with the input that works (draft: "It's quiet in Bay 7 tonight. Type me what's on your mind."); appended to history as an assistant turn so her first reply does not greet again
beats.lights: room tone ducks 6-9 dB; 3420 186 reads slowly under the line
beats.ui: caption in sync; the caption plate fades in (200 ms) with it

beats.name: Handover
beats.resident: turn-yield gaze: eyes on the lens, brows up, a slight head tilt
beats.ui: the input row appears and pulses once; one device-aware hint ('Type to talk with her'; touch: 'Tap here to type'), gone after the first turn

beats.name: Listening
beats.trigger: first keystroke / text in the box
beats.resident: attends: a small lean in, head and chest toward the live camera; about 70 % contact gaze where the rig has eyes
beats.lights: amber INQUIRY lamp on the 1407 key panel (below HOME) lit while the box has text; its twin on the 1401 panel (one steady amber lamp, in HOME) for faceless rigs
beats.ui: listening state on the input; optional typebar echo at -32 dBFS

beats.name: Thinking
beats.shot: HOME (never cut away while she thinks)
beats.resident: planning gaze aversion (down and to frame left); a nod or inhale at 200-600 ms; cached filler at 2.5 s (at most 1 turn in 3); at 10 s an in-character fact plus a fix
beats.lights: INQUIRY off; carriage return and bell; relay chatter from the CPU (-34 dBFS); the 1401 panel lamps chase; 3420 186 (behind her left shoulder in HOME) runs the tape-search pattern (0.8 s forward, 0.3 s stop, 0.4 s back, every 1.6 s)
beats.ui: three dots in her caption within 100 ms

beats.name: Reply
beats.trigger: first sentence audio ready (TTS per sentence)
beats.shot: HOME; CLOSE (portrait: CLOSE_PORTRAIT) for replies >= 6 s at the first sentence boundary >= 1.5 s in, at most once per reply, back on the first keystroke or 4 s after the reply
